$comment: Accepted advisories: high/critical in `pnpm audit --prod`, critical in `pnpm audit --dev`. Each entry: GHSA id, the affected package, why it does not affect Emberline, and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the gate fails until it is fixed or re-reviewed. See SECURITY.md, Supply chain.

advisories.reason: Dev only (vitest 3's worker pool; never in an image). The gadget needs a prototype pollution in the test process first, and the tests run only this repository's code on its own fixtures. Fixed in tinypool 2.1.2, which no vitest 3 release takes; Vitest 4+ drops tinypool. Upgrade vitest before the expiry.
